agyos_skill.intent: Multi-source RSS news aggregation with Claude-powered sentiment analysis and structured briefing output
agyos_skill.instructions: Collect and analyze AI/tech news from multiple sources with Claude-powered sentiment analysis. Open source lite version. - Use when preparing a concise AI or technology news briefing from multiple RSS sources. - Use when you need ranked article summaries with sentiment, tags, and impact scoring. - Use when monitoring industry changes across product launches, policy moves, and infrastructure shifts. - Use when deduplicating overlapping coverage before writing a daily or weekly briefing. - Collects news from 4+ RSS feeds (TechCrunch, The Verge, Ars Technica, Hacker News) - Deduplicates articles across sources - Ranks by importance (industry impact, technology trends, policy changes) - Generates structured briefing with sentiment tags - Outputs formatted briefing card ``` Collect latest AI/tech news from RSS feeds. Rank top 5 by importance to the tech industry. For each: summary (2-3 sentences), sentiment (positive/negative/neutral), impact score (1-5), industry tags, one-sentence commentary. Output as a structured briefing card. ``` ``` AI/Tech News Briefing — 2026-05-13 1.
